answer_1.quote: We construct the input as a concatenation of the question, a mask token and context ... and fine‑tune a text‑to‑text pre‑trained model using the same objective used during its pre‑training to recover the answer. ... The input (x_M) to the model consists of a concatenation of three text sequences ... The target for the T5 variant is a concatenation of a mask token m and y_a.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answer text (span) for a given question and context

answer_2.quote: Our proposed fine‑tuning framework improves the F1 score significantly across all datasets ... FewshotmBART outperforms XLM‑Roberta‑large by an average of 32.96 absolute F1 points for training data sizes spanning from 2 to 64 examples.
